Privacy

A concise explanation of how this portfolio handles contact.

Enquiries

The contact form prepares a WhatsApp message in your browser. The site does not store or submit the form itself. Your message is delivered only if you choose to send it in WhatsApp. Direct email and phone links use your own apps.

Hosting and external sites

The hosting provider may process basic request information to serve pages and protect the site. External project links have their own privacy practices.
